otp_request.explanation: The caller is asking for a One-Time Password (OTP) or authentication verification code.
otp_request.recommendation: Never share your OTP or security codes with anyone. Legitimate banks and organizations never ask for OTPs over calls.

patterns: give me your card number and expiry
share your pan and aadhaar details
credential_theft.explanation: The caller is attempting to extract sensitive financial credentials such as CVV, ATM/UPI PIN, or passwords.
credential_theft.recommendation: Never disclose CVV, ATM PIN, UPI PIN, or passwords. Banks will never ask for private credentials.

bank_threat.explanation: The caller is threatening immediate account suspension, deactivation, or card blocking.
bank_threat.recommendation: Do not panic or comply under duress. Contact your official bank branch or official customer care directly to verify account status.

patterns: scan the qr code to receive
enter upi pin to receive money
scan qr code to get refund
accept the payment request in gpay
upi_payment.explanation: The caller is directing you to perform a UPI transaction, scan a QR code, or enter a PIN to receive money.
upi_payment.recommendation: Do not scan QR codes or enter your UPI PIN to receive money. Entering a PIN always deducts funds from your account.

payment_request.explanation: The caller is directing you to transfer or send money.
payment_request.recommendation: Do not transfer money to unverified individuals or third parties requesting urgent transfers.

government_police_impersonation.explanation: The caller is impersonating law enforcement, customs, or government officials and threatening legal coercion or digital arrest.
government_police_impersonation.recommendation: Law enforcement and government agencies do not conduct investigations or arrest people over phone/video calls. Hang up and report to the cybercrime portal.

patterns: pay processing fee to claim prize
prize_lottery_scam.explanation: The caller claims you won a lottery, prize, or reward but demands an upfront fee or tax to release it.
prize_lottery_scam.recommendation: Legitimate lotteries and contests never require an advance fee or tax payment to claim winnings. This is an advance-fee fraud.

tech_support_remote_access.explanation: The caller is attempting to gain remote control of your device or trick you into installing screen-sharing software.
tech_support_remote_access.recommendation: Do not install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, QuickSupport, or unknown APK files requested over the phone.

investment_loan_scam.indicator: Unrealistic financial returns or loan advance fee
investment_loan_scam.explanation: The caller is offering unrealistic guaranteed returns or demanding upfront fees for pre-approved loans.
investment_loan_scam.recommendation: Avoid high-yield investment schemes and never pay upfront loan processing fees to unknown callers.

patterns: transfer money immediately or legal action
do it right now or face arrest
without delay or your account will be blocked
act immediately or line will be cut
tell me immediately or face consequences
urgency_threat_pressure.explanation: The caller is manufacturing artificial urgency and applying coercive pressure to force hasty compliance.
urgency_threat_pressure.recommendation: Scammers manufacture urgent deadlines to prevent calm verification. Disconnect the call and verify independently.

kyc_expiry_fraud.explanation: The caller falsely claims your KYC has expired and demands immediate online verification under threat of service cutoff.
kyc_expiry_fraud.recommendation: Banks and telecom providers never mandate instant over-the-phone KYC under threat of same-day suspension.

patterns: i am calling from your bank
calling from your bank security department
calling from reserve bank of india
i am your bank branch manager
bank_impersonation.explanation: The caller is posing as a bank security, branch manager, or fraud prevention official.
bank_impersonation.recommendation: Bank security teams never call customers asking for private credentials or requesting money transfers.
